design.name: 冰鲸
design.brief: A young frozen whale that crawls on the shore ice, the artillery: a chunky round-bodied whale calf about 5 m long with a blunt head, small eyes, thick ice crust and barnacles on its back, two big front flippers it uses to drag itself over the ice and a broad tail fluke; a big blowhole on top of its head that glows aqua-cyan when it charges (weak spot) and spouts geysers of ice shards that rain down. Bulky, slow, mournful.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes.
design.turnaround_pose: lying on the ice on its belly, body straight and level, the two big front flippers spread to the sides and resting on the ground, the tail fluke flat behind it, mouth closed, the blowhole on top closed and painted opaque aqua-cyan (no spray, no geyser, no particles)
design.turnaround_digits: both flippers and the whole tail fluke fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body must fit inside the view with margin.
